_comment: ContextKeeper 2.0 — baseline enterprise constraints. Edit to match your project's rules.
constraints: All async functions must wrap await calls in try/except blocks
No hardcoded credentials — use environment variables or a secrets manager
All SQL queries must use parameterised statements (no f-string or %-formatting)
API surface must be versioned (e.g. /v1/, /v2/) before any breaking change
Every public function must have a docstring with at least one Args/Returns description
File I/O must be idempotent: use atomic temp-file writes, create dirs with mkdir parents=True
All new dependencies must be audited against deprecated_rules.json before merging
Python target: 3.11+; Node target: 22 LTS; no legacy runtimes in new code
Test coverage threshold: 80% lines for any modified module
OWASP ASVS L2 compliance required for all authentication and session handling code

rules: V2.1 — Passwords must not be stored in plaintext or reversible encryption
V3.3 — Session tokens must be invalidated on logout
V5.1 — All user-supplied input must be validated server-side
V9.1 — TLS 1.2+ required for all external communications
V14.3 — Debug/verbose error messages must not be exposed in production
